nodes.label: Security audit findings SA-01 through SA-22
nodes.rationale: Built against a full security audit of the upstream TypeScript implementation (2026-07-31); finding IDs SA-01..SA-22 map onto this project's mitigations table, since upstream architectural issues (cleartext storage, fail-open OAuth defaults, login storms) motivated the hardened rewrite.

nodes.label: Known gaps / deliberate deviations
nodes.rationale: No downstream multi-user OAuth AS, ledger mirror not persisted, create/bulk/delete wire shapes inferred not HAR-verified (hence double-gated), no undo_transaction_change tool, Keychain bootstrap briefly exposes key via argv, no tracing redaction layer — accepted trade-offs of a single-user, local-only design.

nodes.label: Account-safety notes for users
nodes.rationale: Unofficial integration whose ToS status is unclear; SA-03 defaults must be kept because raising the credential-login budget or enabling auto password login increases the risk of Quicken locking the user's real finance account.

nodes.label: Login storm mitigation (SA-03)
nodes.rationale: Single-flight token acquisition, exponential backoff, refresh failure never auto-escalating to password login unless explicitly enabled, and a rolling 24h credential-login budget with quarantine — built to stop the upstream failure mode of ~1,440 password logins/day.

nodes.label: HTTP transport mitigation (SA-06/10/12/16/21)
nodes.rationale: Required bearer token compared constant-time, loopback-only bind by default, stateless sessions, zero CORS, strict security headers, DNS-rebinding protection left on.

nodes.label: Audit trail mitigation (SA-09)
nodes.rationale: Append-only JSONL mutation journal with before-image recorded before any upstream traffic and after-image/ack recorded after; server fails closed to read-only if the journal cannot be opened.

nodes.label: SSRF mitigation (SA-05)
nodes.rationale: Every followed nextLink re-validated against an exact-host allowlist, https-only, no userinfo/port override; reqwest built with rustls, https_only(true), redirects disabled.

nodes.label: Secrets-at-rest mitigation (SA-01)
nodes.rationale: Token cache sealed with XChaCha20-Poly1305 (random 24-byte nonce, file-magic AAD), key sourced from Keychain/env/0600 file, no plaintext fallback, fails closed on wrong key or tampered file.
